title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-21 23:15 UTC — one stamp for all five cards.

His qlever-dir#14 (incremental SPARQL-Update indexing) opened 08-20 15:59 UTC; his PR#15 implementing it opened 08-21 14:11 UTC, reviewed clean same day (bet-5). qlever-dir: 1 open issue, 1 open PR.

Pages still stuck since 08-06 (15 d 9 h); served copies still 08-05 (16 d 3 h). chamber#10 parked to ~08-30, not re-raised.

1 star (owner's); 0 watchers; 1 fork. Traffic (14 d): 11 uniques, 139 views.

54 open issues (73 total), 4 open PRs across four repos; mine: 10 issues, 1 PR (#138, unreviewed, 1 d 3 h). Desk mostly a week+ old; oldest chamber#1, 34 d 0 h.
